messages.text:
"Create a completely NEW fantasy MMORPG project called AETHERIA from scratch.

FIRST: CHARACTER CREATION

Before entering the game, show a complete character creation screen.

- Choose male or female character.
- Enter a custom character name. The name must not be empty, must have a reasonable length and must be unique. Display the chosen name above the character in-game and in the character profile.
- Choose between two factions: ANGELS or DEMONS.
- Choose from 3 different classes:

1. Warrior – melee combat, strong armor and powerful attacks.
2. Mage – magical ranged attacks and powerful spells.
3. Assassin – fast attacks, dual weapons and high critical damage.

- Choose different hairstyles and hair colors.
- Choose blue, green or brown eyes.
- Choose one of 3 starting outfit appearances.
- Show a 3D character preview that updates when options are changed.
- Allow the player to confirm and enter the game.

FACTIONS:

Angels have celestial wings and a bright fantasy appearance. Demons have demonic wings and a dark fantasy appearance. Faction choice is permanent. Both factions can play together in the same world.

3D GRAPHICS:

Create a beautiful fantasy world using detailed 3D characters, monsters, buildings, trees and terrain. Use a fixed isometric camera angled diagonally from above. The camera follows the player while keeping its angle and distance fixed. No camera rotation. Keep characters relatively small on screen so players can see a large area.

FIRST PLAYABLE AREA:

Create a detailed starting village with houses, paths, trees, a blacksmith, merchant, quest NPC and storage NPC. Add a surrounding area with monsters.

GAMEPLAY:

- Mobile virtual joystick and attack button.
- One special skill for each class.
- HP and MP bars.
- Monster health bars, enemy attacks and respawning.
- Experience points and character leveling.
- Basic equipment and inventory.
- Loot drops and simple quests.
- Interactive NPCs.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Build a real playable browser game using a suitable 3D rendering engine supported by the environment. Keep code modular and mobile-friendly.

Test character creation, custom name entry, faction selection, class selection, 3D character preview, movement, camera, combat and saving. Fix errors before finishing.

IMPORTANT:

This is the foundation of the larger AETHERIA MMORPG. Prioritize a working character creation system, custom character names, faction selection, all three classes and actual 3D gameplay. Do not build the entire world yet. Make this first playable version stable and expandable.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
